derived_from: public typed contracts and documented scheduling semantics

semantic_groups.expected: Idle debounce is UTC elapsed; 599.999999 seconds no enqueue; 600 seconds eligible; explicit current permit required.
03:00 daily fallback is independent of idle delay; before 03 no daily; owner timezone, same-day completion suppresses daily only.
Across midnight or ISO/year boundary uses owner day; daily catchup supported; last_observed_at later than now blocks rollback.
Ambiguous or missing local 03:00 is blocked pending an explicit host DST policy; no silently shifted instant.
Default/disabled/quota-stopped/inactive/stale permit cannot yield enqueue or work.
Cross owner/subject, revoked/inactive/incognito/optout/future source and temporary/incognito/inactive/running/leased thread cannot be processed.
Stable scope/thread/source cursor/epoch produces stable operation identity; matching queued ledger is replay/no duplicate intent.
Full original source text, revision, role, at, origin, epoch or thread source manifest changes must invalidate prior intent before work.
Work is review-only: excerpts retain original source/role/time/anchors; assistant claims never become user facts.
Sensitive sources preserve original policy: proposal/profile confirmation/stop/reject cannot be bypassed by reflection.
Duplicate/archive/gap/followup/profile candidates never apply, delete, schedule, or claim saved receipts.
Exactly eight about-me sections, in original design order; absent current profile authority yields eight empty sections.
Profile/snapshot/source epoch/current revision/scope and exact source/fact anchors must all remain current.
Revoked/changed/assistant-origin/retired/expired facts cannot reappear even when pinned or manually edited.
Pinned/manual entries are preserved as protected review-only content; reflection cannot overwrite them.
Markdown/HTML controls in source/profile wording are rendered literally, not as executable HTML, links, or new headings.
Derived analysis is labelled inference, never as user original speech; chart section stays unverified without authoritative P8 contract.
Every exposed effect field is true integer zero; no actual model/queue/fact/profile/notification/delete work.
